shared_cil_rules.activation: InputManager.ActivatePlaySpell0x06005a18 only activates root Birth if root activeState=None. OnBirth0x06014b04 creates Start and SafeActivateState(Birth).
shared_cil_rules.gate: SuperSpell.DoAction0x06014b0d checks gameEvents, extraStartDelay, then startPrefab. All current 18 SuperSpells have ShowSpellVisuals0 and startDelay0.
shared_cil_rules.wait: CheckAndWaitForStartPrefabThenDoAction0x06014b16 returns false immediately for already Idle start. Otherwise clones if absent, attaches Birth-finished callback, and only activates Birth if not already Birth. Returns true to defer DoActionNow.
shared_cil_rules.ready: OnStartSpellBirthStateFinished0x06014b17 ignores prevState other than Birth, removes itself, calls DoActionNow.
shared_cil_rules.no_prepare: Without input preparation, Action invokes same gate and creates Birth; full source duration is still awaited.
shared_cil_rules.cancel_input: InputManager.CancelTargetMode0x06005a05 destroys friendly arrow with isLocallyCanceled=true -> TargetReticleManager.DestroyTargetArrow0x0600610b -> Card.NotifyTargetingCanceled0x06012cea -> Card.ActivateHandStateSpells0x06012d89 -> SpellUtils.ActivateCancelIfNecessary0x06014acd.
shared_cil_rules.cancel_spell: SuperSpell.OnCancel0x06014b06 SafeActivateState(Cancel) on existing start, clears m_startSpell. No missile is created by Birth or Cancel. Already committed/flying missiles are not cancelled by this pre-cast branch.
shared_cil_rules.switch: A local adapter changing selection must cancel old active preparation and create/reuse the new card preparation. Exact mouse click selection UI is a compatibility mapping, not an original hover trigger.
shared_cil_rules.audio: PowerSpellController.ActivateCardEffects0x060116bd activates root Action then immediately ActivatePowerSounds0x060116c6; card-level sounds are not deferred by start readiness. Start-FSM Birth/Action/Cancel audio follows the separate raw schedules.
shared_cil_rules.cancellation_sound: InputManager.CancelTargetMode0x06005a05 plays CancelAttack.prefab:9cde7207a78024e46aa5a0a657807845 independently of the Start Cancel-fizzle schedule.

limits: All scalar durations are nominal; original PlayMaker transitions and coroutine zero waits remain frame-quantized.
Reused existing Birth must not be restarted or accompanied by duplicated Birth audio.
Local 5834 rule resolution/RNG remain unchanged; visual readiness is presentation timing, not an added game-rule cost or card eligibility check.
